blocking: Phone, screen one: open the hamburger menu while the header is still over the video. `.site-header--over:not(.is-scrolled):not(.nav-open)` stops matching, so the bar's colour falls back to brown, the red logo reappears, and the bar keeps NO background (only `.site-header--solid, .is-scrolled` get cream). Result: a brown X, brown 'Inquire' and a red logo floating on the dark video while the drawer below is cream.

Phone (index-phone-4.jpg): the left trunk ends in a hard horizontal cut exactly at the top of the painted ground. `.ground::before/::after` carry z-index:1 but `.ground` creates no stacking context, so those pseudo-elements sit in the root context at the same level as the fixed `.tree-frame` (z-index:1) and, being later in the DOM, paint over it. The GSAP trunk fade (end 'top 45%') has not finished when the ground enters, so the seam shows.

fixes.what: Add `.site-header.nav-open` to that selector so the bar gets the cream background, brown ink and shadow whenever the drawer is open (and keep the amber focus rule from applying in that state).
fixes.why: Fixes unreadable brown controls and a red logo on the dark video when the phone menu opens on screen one.

fixes.what: Add `isolation:isolate` (or `z-index:0`) to `.ground` so its `::before/::after` z-index:1 is scoped to the band, not the root stacking context.
fixes.why: Removes the hard cut of the trunk at the ground's top edge on phones; the trunk then fades over the roots as intended.

fixes.what: Prefix with `.js` (`.js .accordion__panel:not(.is-open) .accordion__body`), matching the way reveals are guarded.
fixes.why: Without JS, five of six celebration descriptions are invisible and unreachable on desktop; the triggers do nothing.

fixes.where: site.css `.accordion__panel::after{content:"+"}` and `.is-open::after{content:"\2013"}` (phone block); index.html trigger labels
fixes.what: Use `content:"+" / ""` and `content:"\2013" / ""` so the glyph is not announced; name each trigger just 'Sofreh Aghd' etc. (drop 'Show') and let aria-expanded carry the state.
fixes.why: VoiceOver/TalkBack currently read a stray plus/dash per card, and 'Show Sofreh Aghd' stays 'Show' while expanded.

fixes.what: Self-host gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js and lenis.min.js under assets/js/ (or at least add `<link rel=preconnect>` for cdnjs and unpkg and `crossorigin` + SRI hashes).
fixes.why: Two third-party origins on the critical motion path with no preconnect or integrity; an unpkg hiccup leaves the page static for seconds.

fixes.what: Add a metric-matched fallback: `@font-face{font-family:"Ramillas Fallback";src:local("Georgia");size-adjust:…;ascent-override:…}` and put it before Georgia in --font-latin (or use `font-display:optional` for the first paint).
fixes.why: Every Latin run is 700 serif with unmatched Georgia metrics; on slow networks headings reflow when the woff2 swaps in (measurable CLS).
